summary: Frontend-only Playwright verification of two SvelteKit refactors: (1) Career H2H moved from /records-team into /team/[username], and (2) reusable <TeamBadge> swapped across 6 pages. 7 of 8 acceptance items PASS. One regression found: /standings dropdown defaults to the OLDEST season (2022) instead of the latest.
scope: frontend-only (no backend / no Mongo — pure client-side SvelteKit reading Sleeper public API)
test_credentials: N/A — public Sleeper API, no auth required.
tested_url: http://localhost:3000 (REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL not present in /app/frontend/.env; supervisor frontend is RUNNING on port 3000)

ui_bugs.issue: Defaults to the OLDEST season (2022) instead of the latest. Acceptance criterion #3 explicitly states: 'the season dropdown defaults to the latest available season'. Observed: <select> options are ['2022','2023','2024','2025','2026'] and selected value is '2022'. Root cause: defaultSeasonIdFromChain() in /app/src/lib/leagueStore.js iterates the chain oldest→newest and uses Array.find(), so the FIRST league with status 'complete' is returned — which is the OLDEST completed season (2022), not the LATEST. Suggested fix: reverse the lookup, e.g. `[...list].reverse().find(s => s.status==='in_season') || [...list].reverse().find(s => s.status==='complete') || list[list.length-1]`, or prefer the 'in_season' / latest by season-number sort.

All four season cards data-testid='season-2025|2024|2023|2022' render, each with a per-week matchup table (4 tables found).
/standings: Both Regular Season + Playoff tables render with 28 TeamBadges (every row has an avatar img — 0 broken images). Champion 🏆 trophies present (2 occurrences).

/power-rankings: 14 team rows, all use TeamBadge, all are anchor links (a[data-testid^='team-badge-']). First link href = '/team/samsilverman12' — links navigate to /team/<owner_username> as required.
/honor-hall: Final Standings list has 14 <li> entries, each using TeamBadge size 'lg' as an anchor. First link href = '/team/JFK4312' — clicking navigates to the per-team page.

/records-player: 4 tables render, 69 TeamBadge instances populated across All-Time Best Player by Team / All-Time Single-Season Playoff Best / All-Time Single-Season Full-Season Best / Career Playoff Leaderboard.
Avatar fallback: 0 broken images observed across all pages (naturalWidth === 0 check returned 0).
No JavaScript console errors and no Svelte page errors observed on any of the 6 routes. No 'TeamBadge is not defined' and no 'bind:value' errors.
action_items: FIX HIGH: /standings dropdown default — change defaultSeasonIdFromChain() in /app/src/lib/leagueStore.js to pick the LATEST completed/in-season league rather than the first one found by linear scan oldest→newest. (Same helper is used by ~7 pages per its docstring — verify other pages don't regress.)
critical_code_review_comments: TeamBadge.svelte: uses `meta?.rosterId ?? meta?.owner_username` as testid suffix — both can be undefined for opponents with no Sleeper rosterMap entry, leading to data-testid='team-badge-unknown' collisions. Currently this only happens for BYE rows which already render a separate BYE, so it's cosmetic only.

leagueStore.js defaultSeasonIdFromChain(): uses Array.find() on a chain that is ordered oldest→newest. Picks the first match, so any page that calls this with a chain containing more than one 'complete' league will default to the oldest completed season. This is the root cause of the /standings bug above.

team/[username]/+page.svelte: uses `bySeason[0].myMeta` for header avatar/name (newest-season metadata). If an owner's Sleeper username case-changes across seasons the .toLowerCase() compare keeps it robust — good.
records-team/+page.svelte: H2H section successfully removed; only aggregated tables + margin lists remain. ChampionCounts logic appears unchanged and trophies render correctly in screenshot.

rca_of_the_issue:
Bug: /standings dropdown defaults to 2022 instead of 2026/2025.
Reproduction: navigate to http://localhost:3000/standings → inspect <select data-testid='standings-season-select'> → value='2022' despite options=[2022,2023,2024,2025,2026].
Root cause: /app/src/lib/leagueStore.js → defaultSeasonIdFromChain() does `list.find(s => s.status==='in_season') || list.find(s => s.status==='complete')`. The chain is ordered oldest→newest, so Array.find returns the FIRST completed league = 2022. Sleeper marks every past league as 'complete', so 2022 always wins.
Mitigation: reverse the search order, or sort by `Number(season)` desc before .find(). Example: `const reversed = [...list].reverse(); const active = reversed.find(s => s.status==='in_season') || reversed.find(s => s.status==='complete') || list[list.length-1];`
